Yes. I found 9 groups of claims that share an address. Each group has claims from at least 2 different accidents. **This tool does not show claimant names, so I cannot yet confirm that the claimants are different people.**

**Biggest group: 4739 Benson Overpass, Pasadena (6 claims)**
- C-1026, C-1093, C-1439, C-1202, C-1209, C-1327

- 81062 Ellen Flats Suite 244, Pearland: C-1330, C-1370

**What this means:**
- A shared address is only a possible link. It does not prove fraud.
- Family members or roommates often share an address. A pair of claims may also be the same person filing for two separate accidents.

I can check who filed each claim, starting with the 6-claim Pasadena group, to find out whether the claimants are different people.
